title: [v0.92.1][V3-F] Repair Sprint 5/6 cutover review blockers
body:
Track the bounded remediation branch for the Sprint 5/6 cutover review synthesis.

Scope:
- Keep C-SDLC v2 as live authority until #505 is explicitly reviewed and approved for cutover.
- Repair the Sprint 5/6 review findings that block PR #591 and V3-F readiness.
- Keep #570 and #571 as explicit gate evidence.
- Preserve #505 as the authority-transition decision issue; this issue must not replace or close #505.

Acceptance:
- PR #591 does not prematurely close #505.
- Standalone csdlc-v3 locked CI selection is enforced for v3 changes.
- v3 construction uses a single csdlc binary shape.
- v2 import verifies issue/card digest integrity.
- v3 durable storage, review, finish, and cleanup findings have focused behavioral proof.
- OBS-A/#511 and OBS-B/#512 canaries are exercised against real issue records.
- The remediation PR includes a visible closing keyword for this issue only.

Non-goals:
- Do not cut over authority from v2 to v3.
- Do not merge, finish, or clean #505.
- Do not use raw gh transport.
